**1. `overflow` reset reason string**

Defined in [`source/common/http/utility.cc`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.31.2/-/blob/source/common/http/utility.cc?L1030-L1031) — `Utility::resetReasonToString` returns `"overflow"` for `StreamResetReason::Overflow`. The `Overflow` enum value itself is declared in [`envoy/http/stream_reset_handler.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.31.2/-/blob/envoy/http/stream_reset_handler.h?L33).

**2. Connection pool overflow trigger**

[`source/common/conn_pool/conn_pool_base.cc`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.31.2/-/blob/source/common/conn_pool/conn_pool_base.cc?L137-L179) — When `connections().canCreate()` or `pendingRequests().canCreate()` fails (circuit breaker thresholds exceeded), it calls `onPoolFailure(..., PoolFailureReason::Overflow, ...)` and increments `upstream_cx_overflow_` / `upstream_rq_pending_overflow_`. This is mapped to `Http::StreamResetReason::Overflow` in [`source/common/router/upstream_request.cc`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.31.2/-/blob/source/common/router/upstream_request.cc?L568-L570), then surfaced as the error message in [`source/common/router/router.cc`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.31.2/-/blob/source/common/router/router.cc?L1416-L1420).

**3. Circuit breaker protobuf configuration**

[`api/envoy/config/cluster/v3/circuit_breaker.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/envoy--v1.31.2/-/blob/api/envoy/config/cluster/v3/circuit_breaker.proto) — `CircuitBreakers.Thresholds` message defines `max_connections` and `max_pending_requests` fields.
